title: Artemis III November Launch Sim
description: Artemis launch team members participate in a launch countdown simulation for Artemis III on Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026, inside Firing Room 1 of the Rocco A. Petrone Launch Control Center at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. This marked the first long day simulation for the Artemis III mission where teams combined the cryogenic propellant loading and terminal count portions of the countdown. Artemis III will carry out a series of objectives in low Earth orbit designed to demonstrate critical systems needed for future lunar landings, beginning with Artemis IV.
